appearance_description: Choose StackFerry colors. This only affects this app.
theme_system_description: Follow the operating system light or dark mode.
language_system_description: Follow the operating system language preference.
mica_description: Use system Mica behind the sidebar. Available on Windows 11 22H2 and later.
mica_enabled_description: The sidebar shows the system Mica sampled from the desktop wallpaper.
mica_unsupported_description: Mica is not available on this system. It requires Windows 11 22H2 or later.
routing_description: When a backup queue exists, Codex goes through a local 127.0.0.1 proxy that can switch upstreams. Official login is never queued.
routing_active_description: config.toml currently points at the local proxy. Quitting StackFerry restores a direct upstream.
routing_inactive_description: The queue is empty, or official login is enabled. Enabling a custom provider with a non-empty queue takes over automatically.
routing_queue_empty: No providers in the queue yet. Turn on “Add to failover queue” on a provider card.
routing_failure_threshold_description: Open the breaker after this many consecutive failures and skip that upstream for the rest of the round.
routing_recovery_wait_description: After the breaker opens, wait this many seconds before allowing one half-open probe.
routing_half_open_description: Close the breaker after this many consecutive successful probes.
routing_logs_caption: Metadata only. Request bodies and API keys are not stored.
restart_codex_description: The config was written. Restart Codex or your terminal for it to take effect.
about_description: Manage provider configs for Codex and later CLIs, then write them to local files in one step.
providers_empty_description: Add OpenAI, OpenRouter, or DeepSeek from a preset, switch back to official login, or edit a config.toml overlay directly.
provider_official_description: ChatGPT / Codex official login. auth.json is left unchanged.
api_key_keep_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current key
session_model_description: Maps to the top-level model in config.toml. Enabling a provider, or saving the currently enabled one, writes it. Restart Codex to use it as the startup model. It does not appear in the /model list.
session_reasoning_description: Maps to model_reasoning_effort in config.toml and only applies to the Responses API. max / ultra use more quota. Default leaves the key unset.
session_context_placeholder: e.g. 272000, leave blank for the model default
session_compact_description: Maps to model_auto_compact_token_limit. 900000 is typical for a 1M context.
delete_enabled_description: “{name}” is currently enabled. Deleting it will not switch back to the official config. Delete anyway?
delete_description: Delete “{name}”? This only removes the config from StackFerry.
claude_placeholder_description: This area will manage Claude Code providers. It is a placeholder and does not read or write any config files.
toast_enabled_description: Enabled “{name}”. Restart Codex or your terminal for it to take effect.
toast_enabled_routed: Enabled “{name}”. Failover routing switched to this upstream; Codex does not need a restart.
error_desktop_only: Open StackFerry from the desktop app, not the browser preview.
error_toml_root_not_table: TOML root must be a table
error_overlay_unsupported_top_level: Overlay does not support top-level key {key}
error_overlay_single_provider: The overlay must contain exactly one custom provider table
error_overlay_reserved_provider_id: {name} is a built-in Codex provider ID. Use a different name.
error_overlay_table_not_object: The provider table must be an object
error_overlay_missing_base_url: Set base_url in the TOML overlay
error_overlay_auth_conflict: auth cannot be used together with env_key / experimental_bearer_token / requires_openai_auth
error_models_invalid_url: Base URL is not a valid address
error_models_unsupported_protocol: Base URL only supports http or https
error_models_invalid_payload: The model list could not be parsed
error_official_exists: The official login config already exists
error_secret_storage_unavailable_read: OS secret storage is unavailable, so the API Key cannot be read
error_secret_storage_unavailable_write: OS secret storage is unavailable, so the API Key cannot be saved
error_api_key_required: Enter an API Key, or configure env_key / auth in the TOML overlay
error_store_corrupt: The provider store file is corrupt
error_models_auth: Authentication failed. Check the API Key.
error_models_unsupported_endpoint: This endpoint does not support /v1/models. Enter a model ID manually.
error_models_http: Failed to fetch the model list ({status})
error_models_timeout: Timed out while fetching the model list
